newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Teva buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Teva buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers reiterated a buy rating on Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd, calling a recent sell-off in the shares unwarranted.

-- Cited "misinformation" about a delay in U.S. commercial launch of Copaxone, Teva's multiple sclerosis drug, for the recent selling pressure. Earlier today, Teva said it expected no delay in the launch, which is scheduled for March 31.
-- Gruntal & Co also reiterated an outperform rating on Teva with a two-year price target of $80 per share.
-- Nasdaq-listed American Depositary Receipts rose 13/16 to 54-3/4.
